you first have to love it.
ui.aboutP1: AYIFFA TOURISM is an agency based in Ouidah, in the Atlantique department of Benin. Its public content highlights guided tours, the country's landscapes and the discovery of its communities.
ui.aboutP2: This redesign extends a belief already expressed by the agency: the traveller's time matters. A stay should let you understand places, hear their stories and fully enjoy the discovery.
ui.aboutP3: The agency offers stays that can be tailored and booked privately, as a couple, with family or friends. The ideas here open the conversation; your programme is then built with the team.
ui.statementTitle:

ui.experienceDesc1: In Ouidah, historical accounts sit alongside today's cultures. A guided visit gives meaning to the places, reveals their memory and helps you understand their traditions. Every encounter is approached with care, in respect of the inhabitants and their customs.
ui.experienceDesc2: A pirogue becomes a path. On Lake Nokoué, life revolves around the water; in the southern lagoons, the landscape changes at every bend. The agency presents several boating discoveries, whose organisation depends on local conditions and navigation.
ui.experienceDesc3: Sometimes a horizon is all it takes to change your pace. Grand-Popo invites you to look differently at the coastal landscapes and the waters of the Mono. Build a discovery stop around your wishes, without mistaking the pleasure of the shoreline for a promise of swimming: safety conditions remain essential.

mentions.label: LEGAL NOTICE
mentions.description: This redesign is independent of the historic website. The final legal information must be confirmed before it is officially published.
mentions.notice: Preview version: this page is provisional content to be validated, not a certificate of the company's legal identity.
mentions.p1a:
Trading name shown: {name}
Public location: {address}
Email: {email}
Historic public phone number: +229 67 04 54 07.
mentions.p1b: The number is shown on the redesign in the +229 01 67 04 54 07 format, in line with the national move to ten digits. Its current use and WhatsApp activation still need to be confirmed with the agency.
mentions.p2: The exact registered name, legal form, registration, full postal address, identity of the publication manager, hosting provider details and any professional obligations must be provided and validated by the agency.
mentions.p3: This version does not use the former admin panel and does not modify any data on the production website. Requests created here are stored in an independent database. No payment, contractual booking or automatic email to the agency is made.
mentions.p4: The destinations and tour formats draw on the existing website's public content. Detailed programmes, access conditions, rates, availability, inclusions and cancellation conditions must be confirmed in a quote by the agency. The presence of a place on the website guarantees neither its accessibility nor the organisation of a departure.
mentions.p5: Check the official advice of your country of residence before preparing any trip, in particular for border areas and northern Benin. Entry formalities, health precautions and safety conditions may change. A guide does not replace the advice of the relevant authorities.
mentions.p6: The photographs and their licences are detailed in the photo credits. The new visual identity is a redesign proposal. The photographers and people pictured are not presented as partners, collaborators or clients of the agency.

privacy.label: PRIVACY
privacy.description: Here is what this preview version actually does with the information you entrust to it.
privacy.notice: This policy describes the technical operation of the demonstration. The identity of the data controller, hosting, retention period and final legal terms must be validated before any production collection.
privacy.p1: When you submit the form, the following are recorded: your first and last name, email address, phone number if provided, destination, optional tour, preferred date, number of travellers, your message and your consent. A reference and creation date are attached to the request. Do not send identity documents, bank details or medical information in the message.
privacy.h2: A local record for this redesign
privacy.p2: Data is stored in this application's independent PostgreSQL database. It is neither transmitted automatically to the historic website nor sent automatically to the agency's address. The confirmation shown concerns only its storage, not a booking or a travel contract.
privacy.p3: The form lets you prepare and keep a travel project in this preview space. Your consent is requested before storage. There is no automatic newsletter sign-up, public profile or data sale built into this application.
privacy.p4: After saving, you can choose to send your summary yourself by email or via WhatsApp. These buttons open an external service and may pass the pre-filled text to it. Check the text before sending it. Use of these services is governed by their own privacy rules.
privacy.p5: No public directory or public screen for viewing requests is available. Only the operator with authorised access to the independent database can view them. The demonstration does not yet include scheduled purging; a retention period and deletion procedure must be defined before any production use.
privacy.designP1: The design proposal page lets you save an artistic direction and an optional note, edit them or delete them. This action changes neither the homepage nor the historic website's data.
privacy.designP2: A random identifier is created in the browser's local storage only when you request storage. Its cryptographic hash, your chosen direction, your note and the storage dates are kept in a separate table of the independent database. No identity, email address or travel data is required. Do not enter personal or sensitive information in the note.
privacy.designP3: The identifier is used only to find and manage this choice in the same browser. It is not used for advertising or audience measurement. The preview sharing link does not include your private notes. The "Delete my saved preference" button removes the record and the local identifier. If you clear your browser storage yourself, you lose the key needed to find this choice; the final retention policy remains to be validated before production use.
privacy.p6: This application installs no advertising cookie and integrates no tracking or audience measurement tool. Photographs and fonts are hosted locally. External links are only opened at your initiative. The technical host may keep its own logs, to be documented at final deployment.
privacy.p7: For any question, write to {email}, stating that it concerns the preview version and, if possible, the reference of your request. The final procedure for exercising rights with the redesign operator must be validated before production.

credits.label: CREDITS & SOURCES
credits.description: Behind every image there is a point of view. Find the authors, sources and licences of the photographs and our visual notebook.
credits.filmEdit: This 22-second editorial montage combines two photographs animated by camera moves and ten seconds of aerial video of Ouidah. It is presented without sound or dialogue. It is not a report filmed by the agency or a customer testimonial.
credits.filmLicense: Licence for the three sources: Pexels licence. Adaptations: editing, cropping, zoom movements, fades, poster extraction and H.264 encoding. The video files and their French descriptions are hosted locally; no advertising player or third-party video tracking tool is integrated.
credits.photoNote: All the photographs shown below were taken in Benin. Some are used as mood images for nearby destinations; this is indicated on the relevant pages. They do not necessarily represent the agency's services or customers.
credits.photoAdapt: Adaptations: resizing, compression, on-screen cropping and, depending on the section, colour filter or contrast overlay. Adaptations of CC BY-SA images remain under CC BY-SA 4.0.
credits.typographyText: Cormorant Garamond and Manrope, distributed under the SIL Open Font License, are loaded via Google Fonts. Lucide icons are distributed under the ISC licence. The AYIFFA graphic signature of this redesign is a creative proposal to be validated by the agency.
credits.sourcesText1: The destinations, contact details and services were compared with indexed public content from ayiffatourisme.com, its About page, its quote request page and its local discovery pages. As the historic server was not directly accessible during the audit, commercial information remains to be revalidated before publication.
credits.sourcesText2: The editorial texts of the redesign are presentation proposals. Unverified prices, customer reviews, founding dates, certifications and statistics have been deliberately omitted.

signature.name: Signature
signature.subtitle: Emotion, on a grand scale.
signature.description: A travel company that lets the images speak. A discreet presence, generous breathing space and elegance that never overdoes it.
signature.typography: Serif headings, italic accents and very understated body text.
signature.composition: A cinematic opening, large-format photographs and editorial chapters.
movements: Soft reveals and subtle hover effects
signature.idealFor: Showcasing personalised stays and projecting a premium, reassuring and lasting image.
signature.watchpoint: Keep images light and travel access visible, even within an immersive staging.

terreVivante.name: Living Earth
terreVivante.subtitle: Benin, unfiltered.
terreVivante.description: A more assertive identity carried by faces, texture and the country's colours. The energy of travel takes as much space as the landscape.
terreVivante.typography: Short, bold headings with a few handwritten details in italic serif.
terreVivante.composition: Portraits, asymmetric framing, terracotta blocks and original graphics inspired by texture.
terreVivante.idealFor: Affirming a memorable local personality and putting cultural encounters first.
terreVivante.watchpoint: Balance patterns and colour to preserve readability and avoid a folkloric portrayal.

ligneClaire.name: Clear Line
ligneClaire.subtitle: Travel, simply.
ligneClaire.description: An interface that goes to the essentials. Wishes, destinations and next steps are immediately clear, without giving up emotion.
ligneClaire.typography: A single family, crisp sizes and a hierarchy designed for mobile reading.
ligneClaire.composition: An airy grid, immediately available search and easy-to-browse cards.
ligneClaire.idealFor: Making circuit search and first contact the priorities of the journey.
ligneClaire.watchpoint: Keep a distinctive photograph and editorial tone so it does not look like a generic catalogue.
